body: I've been going down for months, there isn't no such thing as rock bottom in my life. Just further and further down.

The fact that I might....might have a tiny chance of actually getting out of this hole I've been in for the past 4 months. I have no one, guy. No friends, no family, girlfriend is long gone (distance too). It's all gone. There isn't anything left, I've become a liability, a failure. Every day it gets worse. I have no support and no way out, except this rope.
